post.title: Heir to millions from a stranger? It's a scam letter
post.ig:
A stranger with your last name left you millions? That's the scam.

The FTC warned about fake 'unclaimed life insurance' letters in July 2026: a 'law firm' offers to split millions, then asks for fees and your bank info.
USPIS: legitimate law firms or executors do not ask for a fee to tell you about your share of an estate.
Real unclaimed property exists: state programs returned $4.49 billion in fiscal 2024, and searching is free at unclaimed.org or MissingMoney.com. The median claim was $144.30.

Sources: FTC (July 2026), USPIS, NAUPA FY2024 Annual Report.
News and education, not financial advice.
